_comment: What an inflicted sandfall costs out of the instability budget, and how far it can reach (design 5.0).
Difficulty rather than a verdict: you can roof over sand, and the burial hands you the glass to do it
with. Four steps buy the full show -- a twenty-by-twenty column, burying deeper, living longer and
several at once. Opens at 16 with the other phenomena, so which of them an Age shows first is its
leaning's to say. Unwalked under the draw; the numbers wait on the tuning pass.
